strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.subtitle: Pillars, audience, frequency, goals and roadmap. All editable.
strategy.readOnly: You have read access. An editor can create or change the strategy.
strategy.deleteBody: Pillars, goals, milestones and tasks are deleted. Drafts already sent to the calendar stay.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields: one is empty or too long.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.refusal: The AI couldn't produce this proposal. You haven't been charged.
errors.provider_error: The AI didn't respond. Your credits have been refunded.
errors.already_exists: There's already a strategy in this scope.
errors.assignee_not_member: The assignee must be a workspace member.
errors.no_accounts: Connect at least one active account on a network in your frequency to fill the calendar.
errors.no_pillars: Add at least one pillar and save.
errors.daily_limit_exceeded: A day exceeds an account's daily limit. Generate the preview again.
errors.duplicate_text: There are identical texts across different accounts. Change them before creating (anti-ban).

empty.title: No strategy here yet
empty.body: Start from a template (free) or let the Strategist propose one using your brand kit and metrics. Then edit everything.
empty.noAccounts: Without connected accounts the strategy works the same, but you can't fill the calendar.
empty.templatesBody: Pick your main goal. No AI, no cost.
empty.created: Strategy created from the template. Tailor it to your case.

audience.title: Grow an audience
audience.body: Useful, consistent content in a few formats. For creators.

sales.title: Sell a product
sales.body: Problem → solution, honest demos and social proof. For dropshipping and brands.

launch.title: Launch an account or brand
launch.body: Warm-up, identity and first 12 pieces. For new accounts.

ai.title: AI Strategist
ai.body: Proposes a 90-day strategy and roadmap from your goal, brand kit and project metrics.
ai.goalPlaceholder: E.g. sell 100 units a month of my product
ai.notesPlaceholder: Product, budget, available time, what already works…
ai.context: Your brand kit and the project's TikTok/Instagram metrics are sent to the AI (not YouTube). Nothing is published.
ai.notConfigured: AI isn't turned on yet. You can create the strategy from a template and edit it by hand.
ai.done: Strategy proposed. Review it and edit anything you like.
ai.regenerateBody: The Strategist proposes a new strategy for this scope.
ai.replaceWarning: Replaces current pillars, goals, milestones and tasks. Calendar drafts are not touched.

fields.title: Name
fields.summaryPlaceholder: What you'll do and why, in 2–3 sentences.
fields.audiencePlaceholder: Age, country, language, problems and interests.

pillars.help: Recurring topics you post about. The weight (%) distributes the planner's drafts.
pillars.name: Pillar name

frequency.help: Posts per week and preferred time. Each account's daily limits are respected.
frequency.high: More than 7 a week is a lot for a new account. Prioritise quality.

objectives.help: Goals measurable with each network's native analytics.

roadmap.help: Dated milestones and tasks. Send a task to the calendar to create a draft.
roadmap.empty: No milestones. Add the first one.
roadmap.briefPlaceholder: Idea, hook, format. It becomes the draft's starting text.
roadmap.saveFirst: Save before sending tasks to the calendar.
roadmap.toCalendarDone: Draft created in the calendar. Review it and submit it for approval when ready.
roadmap.toCalendarNoAccount: Draft created without a target account: pick one in the editor.

planner.title: Fill the calendar for the next 2 weeks
planner.body: Preview based on your pillars and frequency. Review, remove what you don't want and confirm.
planner.nothing: No more posts fit: daily limits or frequency are already covered.
planner.limitsNote: Respects each account's daily limit, counting what's already in your calendar. A different text per account.
planner.skipped: {count, plural, one {# post doesn't fit} other {# posts don't fit}} due to {account}'s daily limit
planner.caption: Text for “{title}”
planner.draftsOnly: Created as DRAFTS: nothing is submitted or scheduled until you approve it.
planner.aiNotConfigured: AI isn't turned on yet: template texts are used.
planner.aiDone: Texts proposed. Review them before creating.
planner.create: Create {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}
planner.created: {count, plural, one {# draft created} other {# drafts created}} in the calendar.

warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.subtitle: A 7–14 day plan so a new account starts healthy: a daily checklist of actions you do yourself.
warmup.manualOnly: Everything here is done by you, by hand, in the official app. Kreo never likes, follows, comments or posts for you: it's only a guide.
warmup.readOnly: You have read access. An editor can create plans.
warmup.deleteBody: The plan and its checklist are deleted. It doesn't affect your social account.

empty.title: No warm-up plans
empty.body: Create one for each new account (or one you're about to open). Works without AI.

profile.title: Complete profile
profile.body: Photo, name, clear bio and a link where allowed, before posting.

frequency.title: Healthy frequency
frequency.body: Max 1 post a day at the start. Consistency over volume.

original.title: Original content
original.body: No re-uploading others' videos or the same video on several accounts.

aiLabel.title: Label AI
aiLabel.body: If you use AI-generated images or video, apply the network's AI label.

noBuy.title: Don't buy followers
noBuy.body: No likes, views or engagement pods. It's detected and limits reach.

device.title: Same device and network
device.body: No VPN or proxies, and don't switch phones every day.

form.title: New warm-up plan
form.body: For a connected account or one you haven't connected yet.
form.plannedHelp: When you connect the account, the plan will still be here.
form.coach: Personalise with the Coach for your niche

coach.done: The Coach has adjusted your plan.
coach.notConfigured: AI isn't turned on yet: you can use the template and the free adjustment.
coach.replaceNote: The Coach replaces pending tasks from day {day}. Completed ones are kept.

stats.streakHelp: Consecutive days with every task done.
stats.todayLeft: {count, plural, =0 {All done for today.} one {# task left today.} other {# tasks left today.}}

reminders.overdue: {count, plural, one {You have # task from previous days not done.} other {You have # tasks from previous days not done.}} Catch up without forcing it: slow beats all at once.
reminders.today: {count, plural, one {You have # task today.} other {You have # tasks today.}}
reminders.emailHelp: Only on days with pending tasks. Turn it off anytime.
reminders.other: Another member gets the reminders. If you turn it on, they'll go to you.

checklist.title: Daily checklist
checklist.help: Tick each task when done. All by hand, from the official app.

issues.title: Something not working?
issues.help: Tick what's happening and we'll adjust the plan: free with the guide, or personalised with the Coach.

list.restricted: I have a warning or restriction
list.no_ideas: I don't know what to post

issues.added: {count, plural, one {# task added} other {# tasks added}} to the plan.
issues.nothingNew: Those recommendations were already in your plan.
